dict.string: Only if you turn on head gestures: nod with your AirPods to allow a request, shake your head to deny. Motion is only read while a request is open.
Only if you turn on the live equalizer: lets the bars in the notch move with the music from Spotify or Music. Nothing is recorded or stored.
Lets you control Spotify and Music right from the notch (play/pause, next, previous).
Only if you turn on the calendar: shows your next meeting in the notch and reminds you 10 minutes before. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Only if you turn on the calendar: shows your next meeting in the notch and reminds you 10 minutes before. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Only if you turn on headphone alerts: shows your AirPods or headphones and their battery in the notch when they connect.
